title: KP Made Me:
title_q: “A Special Collection Just for What She's Made Of”
headline: Kylie Priscilla, the founder of KP Made Me, made a special collection just for What She's Made Of. Now she says it herself, on camera.
story: Your V1 was a lookbook with no voice. The client now sent new clips where Kylie talks to camera. This version opens on her voice: she made a collection just for this runway. Then she says who she is, and the pieces carry the rest.

Atdhe's note on V1 (Frame.io): we need to cut this video clip here so you can't see the charging buffalo on the sleeve. Suzanne (WNY, phone call with Nick): we cannot show the Bills charging-buffalo logo on the shoulder of her jacket. It must not show anywhere in this cut.
do: Open on Kylie talking, with the hook text on frame 1.
Use her two lines: the collection line first, then her intro.
Keep her full walk down the steps under the intro.
Match your Ms Eye Candy cut: ombre open and close, captions, end card with voice-over.
Rotate IMG_1596 by 180° if you use it.
dont: No logo, wordmark, name or brand card at 0:00.
No Bills charging-buffalo logo on screen. It is on the shoulder of her jacket: cut or crop every jacket shot before it shows (client request).
Do not use the off-camera talk or the 'Just say that again' parts.

bp_intro: All times are mm:ss in each clip, from a speech-to-text pass and a sound check on each line. The frames were pulled from the clips. The new clips are vertical 4K at 59.94 fps, so there is no crop and you have room to punch in.

rows.frame_alt: Kylie in the brown sweatsuit with colored flower patches, in a garden. Medium shot, she talks to camera.
rows.visual: Kylie on camera, IMG_1599.MOV from 00:22.3. Medium shot in the garden. The footage is vertical 4K, so you can punch in a little for the first words.
rows.motion: Hook text on frame 1: SHE MADE A COLLECTION JUST FOR THIS RUNWAY 🌸. It is already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on. Series ombre on the open. No logo, no name, no brand card.

voice.quote: I am working on a special collection just for what she's made of and I'm super excited to premiere it at Highmark Stadium.
voice.src: IMG_1599 00:22.3 to 00:28.7 (second take, the clean one)

rows.music: Music starts on frame 1, upbeat and light.

rows.frame_alt: Kylie walks down the white marble steps toward camera, between big columns.
rows.visual: Kylie walks toward camera down the museum steps, IMG_1595.MOV from 00:04.1. Start wide on the columns, she gets closer as she talks. Keep her whole walk; it is the best moving shot of her.
rows.motion: Name super at 00:07, 2 seconds: Kylie Priscilla / Founder, KP Made Me. At 00:12 one text line: What She's Made Of · Nov 5 · Highmark Stadium.

voice.quote: Hi, my name is Kylie Priscilla. I'm the founder of KP Made Me, and I'm super excited to be part of what she's made of on November 5th at Highmark Stadium.

rows.frame_alt: A rack of hoodies with red and white flower patches and a script 'Buffalo' print, outside between columns.
rows.visual: Hold each shot 2 to 3 seconds (this client likes slow pacing): the rack IMG_1542.MOV, the hoodies on the railing and the flower close-up IMG_1545.MOV, Kylie sitting on the ledge by the water IMG_1592.MOV / IMG_1593.MOV, hood up on the terrace IMG_1583.MOV. You can also use the 'Welcome to Buffalo' close-ups from the first folder (IMG_4223, IMG_4224).
rows.motion: Captions off here (no talking). One text line at 00:18: <q>Made in Buffalo</q>.
rows.music: Music up. Cut on the beat, but not fast.

rows.frame_alt: Kylie stands on a stone ledge against a cloudy sky, trees below.
rows.visual: Kylie on the ledge against the sky IMG_1582.MOV, walking in the garden IMG_1597.MOV, then a wide of the columns IMG_1574.MOV or IMG_1575.MOV. IMG_1596.MOV was filmed upside down: rotate it 180° if you use it. The 60 fps clips can go to slow motion. Let the shots breathe.
rows.music: Small lift into the end card.

rows.visual: The same end card as every cut in this series (the Ms Eye Candy end card). The ombre close. Nothing on it changes for this boutique: no boutique name, logo or handle.
rows.motion: A voice-over reads the end card. This client wants a voice-over on every end card.
rows.voice: Voice-over reads the end card text, the same as every other cut in this series. Do not add the boutique's name.
